title: Batch and live GPT transcription added
summary:
Batch and live transcription arrived, community models gained clearer metadata and healthier listings, and generation got a few sturdier failure paths.

Azure-backed `gpt-transcribe` was added for batch speech-to-text, alongside `gpt-live-transcribe` for streaming transcription over Realtime. Both accept Quest Pollen, and the API docs now list them.

Owners can advertise tool-calling, reasoning, and context-length metadata for text proxies. Hidden models leave listings and fallbacks but remain callable by exact ID; monitoring can hide failing models sooner and relist recovered ones. Community proxies and agents now share typed listings, while managed agents can use every tool advertised by their enabled Pollinations MCP server.

The catalog added The Mita, a Roblox character chat, and Cursor Maker, which turns a description into a Windows cursor design. The dashboard received smaller model-card and mobile-drawer fixes, and the README was refreshed with earlier news.

highlights.title: GPT batch transcription
highlights.text: Transcribe audio with `gpt-transcribe` through `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, with optional language, prompt, and temperature settings. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-transcribe).

highlights.title: GPT live transcription
highlights.text: Stream speech-to-text with `gpt-live-transcribe` over the Realtime API. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-live-transcribe).

highlights.title: Community model capability metadata
highlights.text: Community text-model owners can declare tool calling, reasoning, and context length in My Models or the community-endpoint API. Those declarations appear in the model catalog to help developers find suitable models; they do not change request forwarding. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: More tools for managed agents
highlights.text: Managed agents can use every tool advertised by their enabled Pollinations MCP server, rather than a fixed eight-tool list. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).
